result: Go-Explore archive (affordance-priored, full-action-set) reaches 0/4 hard-tail first-wins (ls20/su15/sk48/cn04) despite deep archives (90-565 cells, maxdepth up to 160). Finds easy/shallow wins (r11l @8 actions) but NOT the deep narrow specific-sequence wins.
conclusion: Go-Explore gives broad systematic DEEP coverage but the hard-tail wins are NARROW specific 13-33 action sequences with no intermediate reward; broad coverage cannot hit a narrow deep win without a GOAL GRADIENT. Confirms the mechanic-agent diagnosis: the tail needs a sub-goal gradient (LLM-as-reasoner: analyze the grid -> hypothesize the mechanic -> propose actions/sub-goals), the SOTA-flagged layer ON TOP of this archive. Blind exploration (diversity + Go-Explore) is refuted for the hard tail.
